name: frame_math_dispatch

test_list.description: Reject missing ExecuteTool authority, foreign frame, denied role or cancellation before evaluation.
Evaluate typed bounded math on its owned blocking task and persist the real result and frame receipt.
Reject content that differs from deterministic evaluation of its recorded call arguments.
Unknown fields do not silently alter the typed operation contract.
